title: AI Value Realization and Benefits Tracking

questions.question: Why is launch not the same as AI value realization?
options: Because value needs an owner, baseline, metric, cadence, and review
Because adoption should not be measured
questions.explanation: Benefits management tracks outcomes after launch.

questions.question: Which signal is part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Adoption lag can explain why expected value is not realized.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked benefits-tracking plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact recommends benefits tracking controls.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: Baseline metrics make value comparisons possible.

questions.question: When should an AI initiative enter a portfolio value review?
options: When expected value is high but baselines, metrics, ownership, or adoption are weak
Only when all value is already proven
Only when no owner exists and no one cares
questions.explanation: High-value initiatives need benefits evidence and review.

questions.question: What should benefits tracking connect?
options: Benefit hypothesis, baseline, adoption, metric cadence, and portfolio decision
Only tool usage without business context
questions.explanation: Benefits tracking links intent to observed outcomes.
